verdict.rationale: gstack keeps cross-session learnings in a local file (~/.gstack/projects/{slug}/learnings.jsonl), and its /learn skill lets users review, search, prune and export them. That gives some hands-on control over deleting retained agent memory. Beyond that, the docs only describe accumulation: per-site domain skills are saved and injected into future sessions, with no documented deletion or retention controls for them. A community post notes gstack has usage telemetry, but the evidence shows no opt-out or retention policy for that data. Missing for 10: retention policies or limits, documented deletion for domain skills and telemetry data, a telemetry opt-out, and independent corroboration of the prune workflow.
